tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun kun spangs chen po la bstod pa mtha' yas ma bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ mtha' yas zhing na grangs med rigs brgya'i gar/ /ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ /gcig bsdus drug pa rdor 'dzin 'khor lo'i mgon/ /khyab bdag bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus skal bzang 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong zab mo'i chos kyi mdzod/ /smra ba'i nyi ma dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso/ /skyabs mchog zla med bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon tshe de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig /'phags pa'i yul na grub dbang lā ba pa/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir kun spangs chos rjer grags/ /bka' drin mnyam med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /srid gsum bde ba sgyu ma'i zlos gar dang / /'khor ba'i khyim kun sbrul dug tshang tshing ltar/ /gzigs nas thub bstan zhi ba'i nags su byon/ /kun spangs chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes/ /bdun cu rtsa gnyis gus pas nyer bsten nas/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul ji snyed pa/ /ma lus khyod kyis gsan la gsol ba 'debs/ /bslab gsum pad mtsho'i ljongs na bde bar rgyu/ /theg gsum gser gyi drwa bas gdong mdzes shing / /thub bstan nor bu'i khur gyis mi ngal ba'i/ /bshes gnyen gnyis 'thung dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen thos pa'i pha mtha' mi mngon zhing / /bsam byung rig pa'i rlabs 'phreng stong g.yo ba/ /sgom pa rin chen bye bas ci yang phyug /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsom pa'i sprin sngon legs bshad bdud rtsi'i gter/ /'chad pa'i sgra brgya dpyod ldan rma bya'i gnyen/ /rtsod pa'i me char phal rgol brag ri'i gshed/ /paṇa chen mkhas pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /lta ba mtha' bral nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /sgom pa 'od gsal nor bu'i dkyil 'khor can/ /spyod pa shugs 'byung 'od stong drwa ba 'gyed/

/grub rig padmo'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan stong shes bya kun la gzigs/ /brtse bas srid gsum 'chi med grong khyer skyong / /nus pas stobs ldan bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dpal/ /'dren mchog phrin las dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /snyan brgyud dngul dkar bye ba 'khrigs pa'i spo/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo nyin bzhin phyogs brgyar 'bab/ /skal ldan sgo gsum dri ma kun sbyong ba'i/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gsal gnyis med rdo rje'i grong khyer na/ /gsang chen gdams pa'i sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrog /bde chen dga' bas myos pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /rje btsun he ru ka dpal gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku mthong bas bgegs kun ring du skrod/ /stong nyid bzhad sgras gnyis 'dzin srid pa zhig /rdo rje'i springs yig khams gsum yongs la sgrog /phyogs las rnam par rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen 'khrul med phrin las gru chen gyis/ /lus can srid mtsho'i pha mthar rab bsgral nas/ /bde chen nor bu'i gling du 'khrid mdzad pa'i/ /'gro mgon ded dpon chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /gang zhig dad pa'i gtsug gi rgyal mtshan rtser/ /rtse gcig gus pas bsten cing bdag mchod nas/ /bslu med thugs rjes dgos 'dod kun stsol ba'i/ /rje btsun yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsod dus byang phyogs gangs ri'i ljongs shed na/ /gsung ngag zab mo'i gad rgyangs sgrog pa la/ /khyod las lhag pa'i seng chen ma mchis pas/ /bsams shing snying gi dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ /skye dang skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bdag dang bdag la ltos pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /skyabs mgon re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas/ /brtse chen khyed kyis 'bral ba med par skyongs/ /rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang gzhon nu ltar/ /'dren pa mchog khyod lus srog longs spyod dang / /tshul bzhin bsgrubs pas zol med mnyes byas nas/

/thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yengs par/ /dben pa'i ri sul nags kyi sman ljongs su/ /lam mchog bsgrub la brtson par byin gyis rlobs/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs rtswa rtse'i zil pa ltar/ /chu bur ji bzhin tshe 'di skad cig tu/ /shes shing las 'bras grib ma ltar nges nas/ /blang dor tshul bzhin byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /'jigs rung me 'obs lta bu'i 'khor ba'i khrod/ /gang du bde ba'i go skabs ma mthong nas/ /yid 'ong thar mchog bsil ba'i khang bzang du/ /da lta 'byung 'dod skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /thar pa'i them skas bstan pa'i rtsa ba mchog /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs legs nos nas/ /dran dang shes bzhin drag pos rtse gcig tu/ /tshul khrims srog bzhin srung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dpag med dus nas bskyangs pa'i 'gro 'di rnams/ /bzod dka' 'khor ba'i ljongs su gnas pa la/ /bcos min byams dang snying rjes kun bslangs nas/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi bcud phyung ba/ /bstan pa'i snying po bla med rdo rje theg /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i sgo gcig pu/ /gsang chen rdo rje'i lam 'di rnyed par shog /dbang bzhis smin cing lam gyis ye shes bzhi/ /thun bzhi bskyangs pas sgo bzhi'i sgrib sbyangs nas/ /sku bzhi mngon gyur rigs bzhi'i gdul bya rnams/ /snyan brgyud bzhi ldan lam bzhis skyong bar shog /rang sems bla ma 'od gsal phyag rgya che'i/ /bsgom bya bral ba yengs med rtse gcig tu/ /bsten cing bka' drin gzhan du mi re bas/ /lhun grub gzhan don rgya chen 'grub par shog /gangs can mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /mthu stobs 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal rje btsun rdo rings pa'i/

/bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun spangs chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal snga nas la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ rje nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod cing bka' drin chen pos 'tsho ba'i blo gsal rgya mtshos glang gi lo nag pa zla ba'i dus kyi mchod pa'i tshe yul dbus dar yul sgom khang gi ri khrod du legs par grub pa 'dis kyang rje btsun chos rje'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //shubhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje btsun kun spangs chen po la bstod pa mtha' yas ma/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
